# GWS Workflow: Weekly Digest

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — one cross-service workflow of the gws CLI: a weekly summary combining the week's calendar agenda with a Gmail triage summary (unread email count), output in json, table, yaml, or csv. Explicitly read-only — it never modifies data, which makes it safe to run on a schedule. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it's a summary, not a full inbox or calendar review — drill down with the individual gws-* commands for detail; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
